newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Biber shares edge toward zero value.
newsitem.headline: Biber shares edge toward zero value.

text.p: Shares in Swiss paper maker Biber Holding AG edged toward zero value on the Swiss Exchange as trading resumed following their suspension on Tuesday.

Biber bonds also suffered heavy losses following news that Biber was selling its two paper mills to Finland's Metsa-Serla and Myllykoski Oy. Biber expects to file for bankruptcy once its 1996 balance sheet has been completed.
Biber's shares were quoted at 10 cents at the opening and later firmed to 30 cents compared with 4.90 Swiss francs on Monday.
Dealers said the collapse in the value of Biber's shares was expected following the sales of its main assets.
Biber's 1987/1997 bond, ex-options, lost 45.50 points to 34.50 percent and the 6-3/4 percent, 1991/2001 bond lost 37 points to 33 percent.
